Any person who is found to be in violation of this Noise Nuisance Code shall be issued a verbal warning and a request to desist from a law enforcement officer. If the offender persists in creating a noise nuisance after first verbal reasonable warning or request to desist from a law enforcement officer, the officer will issue a written warning. If the offender persists in creating a noise nuisance after the two previous warnings, the noise nuisance is a minor misdemeanor with a $150.00 fine. (2.) Any subsequent violation of this Noise Nuisance Code shall be creating a noise nuisance, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree and may result in fines up to $250.00. (3.)
